shared.fam_text_mm: One cozy pajama look for mom and her little girl, made for slow weekend mornings, bedtime stories, and matching photos.
shared.p1_mm: Mom and daughter can wear the same pajama set, with child and women's sizes. Pick a size for each of you separately to build your matching look.
shared.p2_mm: Each size is one two-piece set with a top and pants. Garment length is the top length; pant length is the full pants length. The waist is elastic. Height and weight are a general fit guide, and child ages are typical for those heights. Measurements are approximate, so compare chest and lengths with pajamas that fit well today.
shared.kf1_text_mm: The same pajama set in child sizes plus a women's cut.
shared.kf4_text_mm: Coordinated colors made for mommy-and-me photos.
shared.cta_mm: Choose the sizes you need for cozy matching nights at home.
